2 hours + AFTERNOON → 12:00 PM – 2:00 PM
1 hour + LATE_NIGHT → 9:00 PM – 10:00 PM

2 hours + LATE_NIGHT (21:00) → 9:00 PM – 11:00 PM, does NOT cross midnight
unknown enum → EVENING start (5:00 PM)
